rows.ja: 技術の取得・開発委託・出資

companies.name: ウルトラ・セーフ・ニュークリア(USNC)

relations.text: 破産したUSNCから、主力の原子炉KRONOS・LOKIの資産と特許を2025年1月に取得
relations.text_en: Bought the KRONOS and LOKI reactor assets and patents from bankrupt USNC in January 2025

source.label: NANO Nuclear 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: we closed the acquisition of certain assets related to the KRONOS MMR™ Energy System and the LOKI MMR™ Energy System from Ultra Safe Nuclear Corporation ("USNC").

companies.name: ケンブリッジ・アトム・ワークス

relations.text: ODIN炉の開発を委託しており、2025年9月にODINの売却に向けた意向書を締結
relations.text_en: Develops the ODIN design on contract; a September 2025 letter of intent covers selling ODIN to it

source.label: NANO Nuclear 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: In September 2025, we signed a letter of intent for the proposed sale of our ODIN™ microreactor design and all associated intellectual property to Cambridge Atom Works
source.note: 売却は意向書の段階です。
source.note_en: The sale is at the letter-of-intent stage.

relations.text: レーザー濃縮のLIS Technologiesに出資(役員が兼務する関連当事者)
relations.text_en: Invested in laser-enrichment company LIS Technologies, a related party with shared officers

source.label: NANO Nuclear 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: Our investment in LIST was unanimously approved by all of our disinterested independent directors.

companies.name: デジホスト・テクノロジー
companies.sub: データセンター・採掘

relations.text: ニューヨーク州の60MW発電所の脱炭素化で覚書を結び、2025年にコンサルティングを提供
relations.text_en: Signed an MOU on decarbonizing its 60 MW New York plant and provided consulting in 2025

source.label: NANO Nuclear 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: we entered into a non-binding memorandum of understanding with Digihost to advance the transition to carbon-free energy at Digihost’s 60-megawatt power plant in upstate New York.

relations.text: 開発中の先進炉の例として挙げる企業の一社
relations.text_en: Named among developers of other advanced reactor designs

source.label: NANO Nuclear 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: These include reactors being designed and developed by TerraPower, X-Energy, GE Hitachi, Holtec, Oklo and Kairos.
